_about: Honey CO2e + water estimate config. Method: Llopis-Garcia (2026), Sustainable Production and Consumption 70, 320-347, doi:10.1016/j.spc.2026.11.003 (preprint arXiv 2606.10660). Factors: SOMA AI Emission Factors (SAEF) dataset v3.2.0, Llopis-Garcia (2026), Zenodo doi:10.5281/zenodo.24460344, licensed CC BY 4.0. Changes: subset only — the H100 central, global-average rows for classes A/B/C (factors_v3_lifecycle.csv) and the token-basis constants (token_basis_constants.csv); values unchanged. Do not refresh from SAEF v3.3.0+: same values, but a non-commercial data licence.
_scope: Cradle-to-gate per token: serving electricity (accelerator energy from ML.ENERGY Leaderboard v3 at <=50 ms inter-token latency, x host uplift 1.5, x idle uplift 1.1, x PUE 1.2, utilisation 0.75), embodied hardware, data-centre construction, and amortised final training run. Grid: global average 0.4832 kg CO2e/kWh lifecycle (Ember 2023 World), location-based. Water: on-site WUE 0.55 L/kWh on server energy + off-site EWIF 3.142 L/kWh on facility energy, consumption basis (Li et al. 2025); excl-hydro uses EWIF 1.572. The paper calls its energy term best-case (biased low): its serving-regime range is 2.0-2.8x the central factor; gco2High is the conservative high case (+64% on the footprint).
_class_note: Closed models are classed by vendor tier word, as the paper prescribes (small: haiku/mini/nano/flash/lite/luna/terra; standard: sonnet, gpt-4o, gpt-4.1, gemini pro; frontier: opus, fable, mythos, gpt-5/6, astra, sol, o-series, codex). First rule hit wins; '-mini' keeps its dash so 'gemini' does not read as mini. Unmapped -> C (highest intensity). A class value is the mean of its measured open-weight members, an assumption to disclose for closed models.
_savings_note: Output-token reduction vs a no-Honey baseline. Saved CO2/water = the saved output tokens through the same token method, so the saving is a small share of a cache-heavy agentic session's footprint (input and cache reads count too). This is a MODELLED counterfactual carried over from the benchmark — it is NOT measured for the session being reported, and every consumer must say so. 'full' is the paired per-task median from the committed stamp in savings_provenance (all task tiers, not the flattering code-only slice); lite/ultra keep their historical ratio to 'full' and remain extrapolations, never measured. Per tier on the same stamp: code -39% (p=0.007), user-facing -7% (ns, p=0.673), agent-to-agent -49% (n=2). $ savings run lower than CO2 since input isn't cut — and can go negative on a cold session.
_savings_provenance_note: Which measurement the ratio above came from. by_model gates the claim: a session whose model matches no key here gets NO savings line rather than an extrapolated one. An entry's 'n' overrides the suite-wide count when tasks were excluded (fable: cells with stop_reason 'refusal' — Fable 5 refuses some bare bench prompts — are dropped from pairing; see the stamp's report.md). Regenerate after a live bench with: node bench/src/report.js --stamp <stamp>

savings_provenance.method: paired per-task median delta in output tokens vs baseline; runs collapsed by median; two-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank
